areas.label: Docks
areas.desc: Where the player start their dungeon delve

areas.label: Beast Cave
areas.desc: A cave with a dangerous beast sleeps, smells of fresh kill and the taste of copper in the air

areas.label: Old Crypt
areas.desc: 5 old effigy tombs sitting in a room, forgotten from a different time

areas.label: The Springs
areas.desc: Three smaller springs to the left side and one larger on the way to the prison. The largest has healing properties

areas.label: Smuggler Storage
areas.desc: Hidden Smuggler Storage recently in use, contains boxes

areas.label: Abandoned room
areas.desc: Whatever used to be in these two adjoining rooms has long rotted away, a single ladder half rotten lies on the ground, one wall has been reached, Eggs glow from the dark beyond

areas.label: Spring
areas.desc: A single spring of life, harboring a water elemental

areas.label: Smuggler Room
areas.desc: A room smugglers used, with a table and four chairs, used as a small base of operation. Used in the past rather, recently hastily abandoned

areas.label: Deep Pool
areas.desc: Two pipes in the wall feed the brakish water which is surprisingly deep. Easy to slip in, hazard, perception to notice, reflex save or drop in. Two Basts/Elemenetal whatever attack

areas.label: Storage Room
areas.desc: A Storage room that has been used by Sable Rei and his people, now abandoned a torch still flickering among boxes, sacks and vases.

areas.label: Spider Smaller Lair
areas.desc: A small alcove the spiders have taken as their own

areas.label: Queen Room
areas.desc: Big cavernours room, a ceiling disappearing into the dark, though hundred eyes are watching, eggs cover most of the wall

areas.label: Old Prison
areas.desc: An Old prison, long abandonded, a journal in a forgotten language still rots here

areas.label: Survivor Room
areas.desc: One of Sable Rei's people has taken refuge in this little hole of the caves, hiding from the spiders

areas.label: Spider Hallway
areas.desc: Guard spiders, hunting for sable rei's men are here looking, hunting for everything

areas.label: The dead room
areas.desc: A dead person lies here, a treasure that can be found in his rotting backpack
